# Pocket Gull - Real-Time AI Clinical Copilot & Care Plan Engine

> Pocket Gull is a high-performance, real-time medical Care Plan Strategy and Live AI Consult engine powered by Google Gemini 2.5. It provides actionable clinical intelligence, manages patient states via FHIR R4/R5 standards, and offers real-time streaming bi-directional voice consultations.

## Core System Architecture
- **Frontend**: Angular 22 Standalone Components with Signals (`signal`, `computed`, `effect`).
- **Backend / SSR**: Node.js, Express, and integrated Angular Server-Side Rendering.
- **Interactive 3D Anatomy**: Three.js WebGL procedural skeletal, organ, dermatome mapping with SIGGRAPH GLSL shaders, SIGGRAPH cardiac double-bump, and Vision Accessibility non-glare fallbacks.
- **Python ML Sidecar & Edge**: FastAPI sidecar (`pocketgull_api`) with calibrated PhysioNet contest models (`physionet_2022` PCG, `physionet_2023` EEG, `physionet_2024` ECG, `physionet_2025` Sepsis, `physionet_2026` PSG) and calibrated ICU 30-Day Mortality, Readmission Risk, and Outbreak Triage classifiers.
- **Mobile Companion**: Flutter / Dart cross-platform mobile suite (`pocketgull_flutter`) with Riverpod BLE multi-vitals telemetry synchronization.
- **Interoperability**: Strict FHIR R4 Bundle export with SOFA score (`LOINC 96790-1`) and LACE readmission risk (`LOINC 80299-1`) observations, plus FHIR R5 `SubscriptionTopic` real-time biometric telemetry streaming (`http://hl7.org/fhir/SubscriptionTopic/biometric-telemetry-stream`).

## WebMCP Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tools & Multi-Paradigm Lenses
Pocket Gull exposes native WebMCP tools and 13 specialized clinical lenses for autonomous AI browser agents:
- `Summary Overview`, `Treatment Matrix`, `Functional Protocols`, `Nutrition`, `Precision Nutrients`, `Monitoring & Follow-up`, `Patient Education`, `PhysioNet Telemetry`, `Y-BOCs Screener`, `Maternal & Postpartum`, `Grow-Thyself Education`, `Epigenetic Longevity`, and `Pre-Conception & Family Health`.
- **Preemptive Hypoglycemia Alert & Rescue Routing**: Automatic CGM drop warning (<70 mg/dL), Web Speech audio narration, and instant grocery store orange juice rescue routing (`HypoglycemiaAlertService`).
- **Medical Supply & Hospital Navigation Hub**: Off-the-shelf medical equipment finder (Pulse Oximeters, AEDs, CGM sensors, Bandaids, Fast-Acting Orange Juice / Rescue Glucose Gel) with 24/7 hospital ER geolocation (`MedicalSupplyNavigatorComponent`).
- **Precision Chrono-Nutrition & Glycemic Engine**: 8-hour intermittent fasting schedule visualizer, tri-paradigm botanical food matrix (Matcha EGCG, Broccoli Sprouts Sulforaphane, Mung Bean & Ginger Stew, Nisha Amalaki), and -35% postprandial glucose spike simulator (`PrecisionNutritionCalculatorComponent`).
- **Dual-Audience Reading Level System**: Dual plain 6th-grade layperson vs. MD/PhD scientific clinical decoder with Web Speech narration (`MedicalDecoderService`).
- **Optical rPPG Camera Pulse Sampler**: Dermal 530nm green-channel photoplethysmography camera pulse extractor (`SpatialScannerComponent`).
- **1-Thumb Quick-Dial Haptic Vitals HUD**: Tactile touch stepper controls for HR, BP, Temp, and SpO2 with mobile haptic vibration feedback (`VitalsQuickDialHudComponent`).
- **Multi-Vitals BLE GATT Service**: Support for Heart Rate (`0x180D`), Pulse Oximetry (`0x1822`), Health Thermometer (`0x1809`), and Blood Pressure (`0x1810`).
- **Family Pedigree Tree & Risk Pruning**: 3-generation pedigree tree visualizer (`FamilyTreePedigreeComponent`) with interactive risk pruning.
- `get_patient_state`: Retrieves current patient demographics, vitals, CGM continuous glucose monitoring (`cgmGlucoseMgDl`), CMP lab panel, and active symptoms.
- `update_patient_vitals`: Pushes updated vital signs (HR, BP, SpO2, Temp, CGM Glucose) or CMP laboratory values.
- `trigger_fhir_r5_stream`: Toggles live FHIR R5 biometric telemetry streaming.
- `connect_ble_wearable`: Connects to Apple Watch / Garmin Web Bluetooth GATT Heart Rate (`0x180D`), Pulse Oximeter (`0x1822`), Thermometer (`0x1809`), and Blood Pressure (`0x1810`) Services.
- `toggle_dermatome_layer`: Activates interactive WebGL 3D spine & dermatome nerve root mapping with SIGGRAPH shaders and Vision Accessibility controls.
- `generate_companion_sync_link`: Produces dynamic FHIR R4 Smart Launch QR code and deep links (`pocketgull://sync?...`).
- `generate_specialist_handoff`: Serializes patient state into an expanded base64 handoff URL and SBAR note for specialist referrals.
- `generate_care_plan`: Triggers multi-paradigm clinical strategy generation across all 13 specialized lenses.
- `get_webmcp_tool_catalog`: Exposes schema tool catalog at `/api/webmcp/tools` for agentic browser tool discovery.

## AI Agent Guidance
When navigating or controlling Pocket Gull:
1. Always verify patient consent and ethics pledge before accessing clinical metrics.
2. Utilize standalone Angular signals for state inspection.
3. Ensure all clinical data payloads adhere strictly to FHIR R4 bundle specifications.
